Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized inspection
In many enterprises, a central network team owns every virtual private cloud (VPC) and subnet, and every flow between VPCs must pass a central firewall in both directions. Agents that call internal REST APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, must meet the same two requirements. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale, with any framework or model.
This post shows a pattern that meets both requirements. The network team keeps ownership of every subnet, and traffic between the Gateway and your private APIs and MCP servers crosses the central firewall in both directions. It covers where to place the Amazon VPC Lattice resource gateway that the Gateway uses to reach private targets. It also covers who owns each piece, six configuration decisions, and the checks that confirm the pattern works.
We built and tested the pattern in the US East (N. Virginia) AWS Region (us-east-1), in a lab with three member accounts and a management account in AWS Organizations. The AWS CloudFormation templates, test scripts, test evidence, and reference material (address plan, full validation checks, troubleshooting, quotas) are in the companion repository. Use the pattern as a guideline and adjust it to your own account architecture.
Terms used in this post
- Resource gateway: The Amazon VPC Lattice entry point into a VPC: elastic network interfaces (ENIs) in subnets you choose. Backends see its addresses as the source of each connection.
- Resource configuration: A VPC Lattice object that names one backend (here, an internal load balancer or VPC endpoint DNS name and port) behind a resource gateway. You can share it with other accounts through AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).
- Managed mode and self-managed mode: The two private endpoint options for Gateway targets. In managed mode, AgentCore creates the resource gateway for you. In self-managed mode, you create it and give the target a resource configuration.
When to use this pattern
Use this pattern when all of the following are true:
- A network account owns every VPC, subnet, and AWS Transit Gateway attachment, and shares application subnets through AWS RAM.
- A central firewall in an inspection VPC must inspect traffic entering and leaving every VPC.
- Application teams manage only their own resources and security groups.
Otherwise, one of the options in Table 1 fits better.
Table 1: When another option fits better.
| Your environment | Use | 
| The Gateway account can own subnets that reach your tools | Managed mode | 
| Traffic between the Gateway and the tools doesn’t need central inspection | Self-managed mode, as documented | 
| Tools are reachable on public endpoints | A standard Gateway target | 
We also considered managed mode in subnets that AgentCore owns, a resource gateway in each tool VPC or in the central endpoints VPC, and internet-facing load balancers with AWS WAF per tool. The alternatives write-up explains why each falls short under these constraints.
Design requirements for centralized inspection
- The network account owns every subnet. The Gateway and application accounts build only in subnets shared to them through AWS RAM.
- Every flow between VPCs crosses the central firewall, in both directions. The central firewall in the inspection VPC inspects the traffic between the Gateway and your private APIs and MCP servers.
AgentCore Gateway reaches private targets through a VPC Lattice resource gateway, and the two private endpoint modes place it differently. Managed mode creates it in the Gateway account, which fits environments where that account can own the subnets it runs in. Self-managed mode, as documented, places it in subnets with direct access to the backend, which fits environments that do not require inspection between the Gateway and the tool. This environment needs both conditions at once, so the pattern uses self-managed mode with one change. The network account owns the resource gateway and places it in subnets routed through AWS Transit Gateway, so every request and reply passes the inspection VPC.
Solution overview
Give the resource gateway its own VPC and subnets in the network account. Don’t share them, and keep backends out of them. Route them through the transit gateway so every request and reply between VPCs crosses the firewall. Share one resource configuration per backend with the AgentCore account through AWS RAM. Figure 1 shows the accounts, VPCs, and traffic path.
Traffic path
- The agent, in a shared subnet with no internet route, calls the Gateway URL. Private DNS on the Gateway interface endpoint resolves it inside the agent’s VPC.
- AWS WAF, if attached, evaluates the request. The Gateway checks its resource policy and the inbound JSON Web Token (JWT), then picks the target and tool.
- The Gateway gets an outbound OAuth token for the tool account and sends the request through VPC Lattice to the resource gateway in the network account.
- The resource gateway subnets route to the transit gateway, which sends the traffic through the inspection VPC to the tool account’s internal Application Load Balancer (ALB) or execute-api endpoint. (Crosses the firewall.)
- The ALB or Amazon API Gateway validates the token and forwards the request to the backend.
- The response returns the same way. (Crosses the firewall.)
How does Gateway traffic enter the network account’s VPC without a transit gateway attachment in the AgentCore account? When you create a target, AgentCore associates the shared resource configuration with its own VPC Lattice service network. VPC Lattice then delivers connections from that service network to the resource gateway’s network interfaces in your VPC. AWS operates that hop, and from there your routes and firewall take over.
What this pattern doesn’t do. Check these limits against your requirements before you adopt it:
- No payload inspection – Traffic is TLS end to end from the Gateway to the ALB, with a certificate the Gateway validates. The firewall sees flow metadata and the TLS Server Name Indication (SNI), not payloads. Request content is in the Gateway, AWS WAF, and ALB logs.
- Some legs skip the firewall – The agent-to-interface-endpoint leg and the Gateway-to-resource-gateway leg don’t cross it. Neither do the token requests that AgentCore makes to each identity provider.
- No end-user identity at the tool – With the client credentials grant, every call that reaches the tool carries the Gateway’s client identity. To trace a call to a caller, use the inbound JWT claims in the Gateway application logs.
Who owns what
Table 2: Who creates what.
|  | One time | New API on a connected ALB | New ALB or tool account | 
| Network team | Resource gateway and its VPC, subnets, and routes. Firewall rules. A default route from the tool VPC to the transit gateway for the ALB’s signing-key fetch. Gateway interface endpoint and policy. AWS RAM share | Nothing | One resource configuration added to the share. A firewall rule if the range is new | 
| Tool team | An ALB certificate whose subject alternative name matches the target host name that the AgentCore team uses | A listener rule (with jwt-validation) on their ALB | An internal ALB and security group, and an app client for the Gateway (client credentials grant, with a scope such as tools/invoke) | 
| AgentCore team | Gateway, inbound authorizer, resource policy, optional AWS WAF | One Gateway target per API or MCP server | A target, plus an OAuth credential provider for a new identity provider | 
A new operation or tool on an existing target needs no new target: update the OpenAPI spec with UpdateGatewayTarget, or call SynchronizeGatewayTargets for an MCP server. The repository’s build order lists the steps in each account and the values the teams pass to each other.
Prerequisites
- An organization in AWS Organizations with resource sharing in AWS RAM enabled.
- AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) 2.37.7 or later, or the AWS SDK for Python (Boto3) 1.43.106 or later, for the certificateConfigurations parameter.
- For the role that creates Gateway targets: vpc-lattice:GetResourceConfiguration, vpc-lattice:CreateServiceNetworkResourceAssociation, vpc-lattice:GetServiceNetworkResourceAssociation, vpc-lattice:ListServiceNetworkResourceAssociations, and vpc-lattice:AssociateViaAWSService, plus the bedrock-agentcore target actions. Check your service control policies (SCPs) if your organization doesn’t use VPC Lattice today.
- A firewall in a central inspection VPC attached to the transit gateway with appliance mode enabled.
Key design decisions
The snippets are excerpts from the lab templates and use the lab’s address plan. RGW_NET is the resource gateway subnets (10.0.1.0/24–10.0.3.0/24), TOOL_NET is the tool VPC (10.12.0.0/16), and ALB_NET is the ALB subnets in it.
Decision 1: Put the resource gateway in a dedicated VPC in the network account
Create a dedicated VPC in the network account for the resource gateway, with subnets you don’t share and no central endpoints or backends. Route those subnets to the transit gateway. Keep one resource gateway per trust zone.
Used only with AgentCore, the resource gateway consumes one IP address per subnet, so small subnets are enough. Two settings can’t be changed after creation, Ipv4AddressesPerEni and ResourceConfigDnsResolution, so choose them up front. Use Availability Zone IDs that VPC Lattice and your AgentCore features support. The lab layout lists them for us-east-1.
Decision 2: Create one resource configuration per load balancer, and share it through AWS RAM
Point the resource configuration at the internal ALB DNS name and share it with the AgentCore account. Don’t start the name with rcfg-, which VPC Lattice reserves.
VPC Lattice delivers the connection to the resource configuration’s domain. AgentCore sends the target URL’s host name (for example tools.example.internal) as the SNI and checks the ALB certificate against it. The certificate’s subject alternative name must match that host name. The host name doesn’t need to resolve in DNS.
For private API Gateway REST APIs, point one resource configuration at the network account’s execute-api interface endpoint. Each API’s target uses its own URL, and each API’s resource policy must allow that endpoint through aws:SourceVpce. In our tests, a second API in another account worked through the same resource configuration with no network change.
Decision 3: Pass only the flows you need through the firewall
Your firewall needs two stateful allows: from the resource gateway subnets to the tool VPC on port 443, and from the ALB subnets to the identity provider’s host name on port 443. Session-based firewalls pass replies of an allowed flow. In the lab we used AWS Network Firewall with strict rule order and the default actions Drop established and Alert established. With these defaults, the firewall drops client-to-server packets that no rule passes, and lets replies through unless a rule drops them. The rule-order notes explain the semantics.
The first rule allows only the resource gateway subnets to reach the tool VPC on port 443. The second allows the ALB to fetch its identity provider’s signing keys (JSON Web Key Set, or JWKS), only from the ALB subnets and only to the identity provider’s host name. The tool VPC needs a default route to the transit gateway for this fetch to reach central egress. If your identity provider isn’t Amazon Cognito, replace the host name. Without this rule, in our tests, the ALB returned HTTP 500 and the agent received MCP invocation failed.
To prove replies cross the firewall, we added a drop rule for the reply direction preceding the pass rule:
Tool calls then hung until timeout, and the firewall logged to_client drops for sid 100098. Removing the rule restored the calls. Run the same test on your own firewall.
Decision 4: Validate the tool account’s token on the internal ALB or private API
The tool account keeps its own identity provider (Amazon Cognito in the lab) and creates an app client for the Gateway. Validate that client’s token on every path to the backend.
Internal ALB – Make the listener’s default action a fixed response, and put a jwt-validation action on every rule that forwards. Pin client_id to the Gateway’s app client so that other clients in the same user pool are rejected.
In our tests, a target with no token, one with another identity provider’s token, and one with a different app client’s token were all rejected with HTTP 401 before the backend ran. The agent saw only An internal error occurred, so use the ALB access logs to diagnose token problems.
Private REST API – An API key doesn’t authenticate the caller, so add an authorizer to every method, such as a Cognito user pool authorizer with a required scope (as in the lab). Also attach an endpoint policy to the execute-api endpoint that limits it to APIs owned by approved accounts. It controls which APIs the endpoint reaches, not who calls it. The authorizer controls the caller.
The ALB or endpoint security group allows only the resource gateway subnets, so the resource gateway is the only network path in. If your firewall applies source NAT, the security group must allow the firewall’s addresses instead, and it then admits anything the firewall forwards. The firewall rule and the token validation become the controls.
Decision 5: Create Gateway targets that reference the shared resource configuration
Create the Gateway with a JWT authorizer and, optionally, an AWS WAF web access control list (web ACL), which inspects the tool-call arguments for every target. AWS WAF inspects only the first 16 KB of the body by default (adjustable to 64 KB), so decide how each rule handles larger bodies. Add AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet to the common rule set. See the AWS WAF notes.
Gateway targets with a private endpoint can’t use NO_AUTH for inbound authorization unless you configure an interceptor function.
Each target needs an OAuth credential provider that holds the tool account’s app client ID and secret and the identity provider’s discovery URL:
If the ALB uses a certificate from a private certificate authority (CA), also store the CA certificate as a PEM string in an AWS Secrets Manager secret. The Gateway execution role (the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role you give the Gateway when you create it) needs permission to read that secret and the credential provider.
An OpenAPI target uses the same blocks with openApiSchema in place of mcpServer. To rotate the CA, update the secret and call UpdateGatewayTarget. Open connections can keep the old trust material for up to 15 minutes.
Keep the Gateway the only consumer of the shared resource configuration. The AWS managed permission for AWS RAM also grants ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint, so the AgentCore account could reach the backend through a resource VPC endpoint or service network of its own. A customer managed permission can’t fix this: AWS RAM rejects vpc-lattice:AssociateViaAWSService in one, and without it Gateway targets fail. Attach an SCP to the AgentCore account instead:
With this SCP, our attempts to create a resource VPC endpoint and a service network association of its own were denied, and a new Gateway target still reached READY. SCPs don’t apply to the management account, so don’t run AgentCore there. In the network account, alarm on unexpected associations with an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches the AWS CloudTrail event CreateServiceNetworkResourceAssociationBySharee.
Revoke access by deleting the Gateway targets (or the service network resource association) first, then removing the resource configuration from the share. Removing it from the share alone doesn’t remove existing associations.
Decision 6: Reach the Gateway privately, and close the public endpoint
Create the Gateway interface endpoint in the shared agent VPC with private DNS enabled, and attach an endpoint policy that lists the approved Gateways. The principal must be *, because the Gateway authenticates callers with bearer tokens. The Resource list is the control.
In our tests, a second Gateway called through the same endpoint returned JSON-RPC error -32002 Insufficient permissions, but still answered on its public endpoint.
The interface endpoint doesn’t close the Gateway’s public endpoint. Attach a resource policy that allows bedrock-agentcore:InvokeGateway only when aws:SourceVpce is your endpoint and denies it otherwise (the full policy is in the repository). In our tests, internet calls returned -32002 about 30 seconds after we applied it, while endpoint calls kept working. AWS notes policy changes can take up to 15 minutes.
An agent with no internet route still needs its inbound JWT. Give it a path to its identity provider’s token endpoint, such as a route to the transit gateway and a firewall rule scoped like the JWKS rule in Decision 3. Alternatively, use a private identity provider.
Validate the pattern in your environment
Before you rely on the pattern, run these checks in a non-production copy of your network account, with your own firewall. The full list of 14 checks, with how to run each and the results we saw, is in the repository, along with a log source for every hop.
- Requests come from the resource gateway – The ALB access log shows a source IP in the resource gateway range (or your firewall’s range, if it applies source NAT).
- Requests cross the firewall – Firewall flow logs show TLS flows from resource gateway addresses to the tool account on port 443.
- Replies cross the firewall – With a reply-direction drop rule in place (Decision 3), calls fail and the firewall logs to_client drops.
- The ALB and private API are token boundaries – Targets with no token, or another client’s token, get HTTP 401 and the backend isn’t invoked.
- The public Gateway endpoint is closed – With the resource policy attached, internet calls get -32002 and endpoint calls succeed.
If a check fails or the agent gets a generic error, the troubleshooting guide maps each symptom to the log that shows the cause.
Considerations
- Cost: Each VPC Lattice service network resource association carries an hourly charge plus data processing. See VPC Lattice pricing. Plan for one association per target. To see how many associations your targets create, compare the resourceAssociationArn that GetGatewayTarget returns for each target, and prefer one target per API or MCP server over many small targets.
- Traffic to public endpoints: Three calls leave the private path: the ALB’s JWKS fetch, the agent’s inbound token request, and AgentCore’s outbound OAuth token requests to each identity provider.
- Account layout and quotas: Gateway tool-call quotas apply per account as well as per gateway. Use one AgentCore account per environment, and split gateways by domain or agent group well before the limits. VPC Lattice closes idle connections, so use keepalives for long-lived MCP streams. The repository lists the other quotas.
- Scope of our tests: We used AWS Network Firewall, no source NAT, and us-east-1 only. Source NAT, multiple Regions, private identity providers, and OpenAPI limitations are covered in the other considerations.
Conclusion
When your network team owns every subnet and every flow between VPCs must pass a central firewall, place the VPC Lattice resource gateway in the network account and route its subnets through the transit gateway. The network team sets up the entry point once and adds one resource configuration per backend load balancer. Application teams keep owning only their load balancers, security groups, identity providers, and Gateway targets, and AWS WAF moves from per-tool public load balancers to the Gateway. Run the validation checks in your own environment before you rely on the pattern.

articles.title: Blutzucker messen ohne Nadel: Dieser Zahnseidestick analysiert Flüssigkeit am Zahnfleisch
articles.text:
Statt Pikser in den Finger: Mikrofluidik-Zahnseide misst Glukose und Harnsäure im Mund
Ein Team der Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) sowie der University of Hong Kong (HKU) in der gleichnamigen chinesischen Sonderverwaltungszone hat ein Analysegerät in Form eines Zahnseidesticks entwickelt. Wie aus einer im Wissenschaftsmagazin „Science Advances“ veröffentlichten Studie hervorgeht, sammelt das unter der Leitung der Chemieingenieurin Hnin Yin Yin Nyein konstruierte „Gingival Fluid Device“ (GFD) winzige Flüssigkeitsmengen aus der Zahnfleischfurche und wertet sie direkt im Handstück elektrochemisch aus.
Innerhalb von drei Minuten ermittelt das System vier Biomarker: Glukose, Harnsäure, Wasserstoffperoxid sowie den pH‑Wert. Anders als Speichel, der durch Nahrung, Getränke und schwankende Produktionsmengen stark verdünnt wird, stammt die sogenannte gingivale Sulkusflüssigkeit aus dem Blutserum und spiegelt sowohl den systemischen Stoffwechsel als auch lokale Entzündungen im Mundraum wider.
Warum die Hongkong-Universität auf Sulkusflüssigkeit setzt
Für Menschen mit chronischen Stoffwechselerkrankungen wie Diabetes mellitus besteht ein direkter Zusammenhang zwischen Blutzuckerwerten und der Mundgesundheit, da ihr Risiko für eine Parodontitis dreimal so hoch ist wie in der Allgemeinbevölkerung. Diese Wechselwirkung verläuft in beide Richtungen: Ein dauerhaft erhöhter Blutzuckerspiegel begünstigt den Abbau von Zahnhaltegewebe, während unbehandelte Zahnfleischentzündungen über Entzündungsbotenstoffe wiederum die Einstellung des Blutzuckers erschweren. „Unsere Plattform könnte es Patient:innen ermöglichen, in Echtzeit zu beobachten, wie sich die Gesundheit ihres Zahnfleisches auf ihren Glukosespiegel auswirkt – und so eine Rückkopplungsschleife schaffen, die sowohl die Mundhygiene als auch das Selbstmanagement des Stoffwechsels stärkt“, schreiben die Autor:innen laut einer Mitteilung auf Eurekalert.
Dass die Sulkusflüssigkeit aus dem schmalen Spalt zwischen Zahn und Zahnfleisch bisher kaum für Heimtests genutzt wurde, liegt an ihrem geringen Volumen von weniger als 0,5 Mikrolitern pro Messstelle. In der Zahnmedizin mussten bisher saugfähige Papierspitzen für jeweils 30 Sekunden in mehrere Zahnfleischtaschen eingeführt, die Proben anschließend zusammengeführt und für die Laboranalyse künstlich verdünnt werden.
Pektin, Seilzug und Gold-Nanopartikel: Die Mikrofluidik im Zahnseidestick
Herkömmliche Zahnseide eignet sich für diese Probenentnahme nicht: Aus vielen Einzelfasern geflochtene Fäden (Multifilamente) aus Nylon oder Seide saugen die Flüssigkeit zwar auf, halten sie aber in ihrem Fasernetz fest, während glatte Einzelfasern (Monofilamente) aus Polytetrafluorethylen (PTFE, bekannt als Teflon) wasserabweisend sind und kaum Tropfen aufnehmen.
Das Team um den Erstautor Yixin Yan, die Ko-Erstautorin Asmita Veronica und den Ko-Erstautor Chaoqi Wang spannte daher zwei 0,1 Millimeter dünne PTFE-Monofilamente parallel nebeneinander. Damit auf dem glatten Teflon überhaupt eine Beschichtung haftet, behandelten die Forscher:innen die Fäden zunächst mit elektrisch geladenem Sauerstoffgas (Sauerstoffplasma) und überzogen sie dann mit einer zehn Mikrometer dünnen Schicht aus lebensmittelechtem Pektin, einem pflanzlichen Geliermittel, wodurch die Oberfläche moderat wasseranziehend wurde.
Wird dieser Doppelfaden für rund 20 Sekunden in die Zahnfleischfurche eingeführt, verringert die mechanische Reibung kurzzeitig die Zähflüssigkeit des Sekrets, sodass es leichter abfließt. Beim Herausziehen schließt sich die Flüssigkeit zu einer stabilen Brücke zwischen den beiden Fäden zusammen, woraufhin ein im Einweg-Aufsatz integrierter mechanischer Seilzug den Faden einzieht und durchschnittlich 95,5 Prozent des Tropfens in einen 0,8 Millimeter breiten und 0,1 Millimeter hohen Mikrofluidik-Kanal, eine haarfeine Röhre für kleinste Flüssigkeitsmengen, befördert.
Am Boden dieser Messkammer sitzt ein pyramidenförmig geschichteter Stapel aus hauchdünnen Goldelektroden, deren Oberfläche durch aufgetragene Gold-Nanopartikel angeraut und um 230 Prozent vergrößert wurde. Durch diese größere Kontaktfläche fließt der Messstrom deutlich leichter zwischen Flüssigkeit und Elektrode. Der elektrische Widerstand an der Grenzfläche (Ladungstransferwiderstand) sinkt von 8.622 auf unter 500 Ohm, was die Empfindlichkeit des Sensors um das 17,6-Fache erhöht.
Da die chemische Reaktion in derart kleinen Kanälen stark von der Tropfengröße abhängt, misst ein vorgeschalteter Volumensensor zunächst 50 Sekunden lang die einströmende Menge: Jedes Mal, wenn weitere 0,1 Mikroliter über feine Kontaktstreifen fließen, schließt sich ein Kontakt und erzeugt einen elektrischen Stromimpuls, anhand dessen ein Mikrocontroller im wiederverwendbaren Griffstück die Werte korrigiert und per Bluetooth an eine Smartphone-App sendet.
Glukose, Harnsäure und Parodontitis: Klinische Tests mit 34 Proband:innen
In klinischen Pilotstudien testeten die Wissenschaftler:innen das System an insgesamt 34 Personen, darunter 16 gesunde Proband:innen sowie 18 Patient:innen mit Typ-2-Diabetes, Hyperurikämie (erhöhte Harnsäurespiegel, die zu Gicht führen können), Zahnfleischentzündungen (Gingivitis) oder Parodontitis. Über die auf den Elektroden fixierten Enzyme Glukoseoxidase und Urikase bestimmte der Zahnseidestick die Konzentrationen von Zucker und Harnsäure, die eine hohe Übereinstimmung mit parallel entnommenem Kapillarblut aus der Fingerbeere zeigten (Korrelationskoeffizient r = 0,89 bei Glukose und r = 0,78 bei Harnsäure, wobei ein Wert von 1,0 für eine deckungsgleiche Kurve steht) und 20 von 24 getesteten Personen (83,3 Prozent) der richtigen diagnostischen Gruppe zuordneten.
Gleichzeitig erfasste das Gerät lokale Entzündungsprozesse im Gebiss über Wasserstoffperoxid, ein Nebenprodukt von reaktiven Sauerstoffverbindungen, die bei Immunreaktionen entstehen, sowie über eine Schicht aus dem elektrisch leitfähigen Kunststoff Polyanilin, die auf Schwankungen des pH-Werts reagiert. An entzündeten Zahnfleischtaschen, die beim zahnärztlichen Sondieren bluteten, war die Wasserstoffperoxid-Konzentration mit durchschnittlich 107,5 Mikromolar (Mikromol pro Liter) rund 2,6-mal so hoch wie an gesunden Stellen (41,5 Mikromolar), während sich der pH-Wert durch den bakteriellen Abbau von Proteinen von neutralen 7,04 in den basischen Bereich auf durchschnittlich 7,84 verschob.
Hoher Speichelanteil und Laborprotokoll: die Hürden für das Gingival Fluid Device
Ein Blick in das Begleitmaterial der Studie zeigt allerdings, dass zwischen dem Prototyp und einer unkomplizierten Anwendung im heimischen Badezimmer noch deutliche Hürden liegen. In drei der vier Teilstudien führte nicht die Testperson selbst, sondern eine geschulte Fachkraft die Zahnseide ein, nachdem die Proband:innen mindestens acht Stunden gefastet, ihre Zähne geputzt, den Mund dreimal ausgespült, 30 Minuten lang nichts getrunken und das Zahnfleisch mit steriler Gaze trockengelegt hatten.
Der eigentliche unüberwachte Alltagstest zu Hause, bei dem die Zahnseide über 25 Stunden hinweg mit einem kontinuierlichen Glukosemessgerät (CGM) am Arm abgeglichen wurde, fand lediglich an einem einzigen gesunden Probanden statt. Auch dieser musste nach den Mahlzeiten ein festes Spül- und Trocknungsprotokoll einhalten. Hinzu kommt, dass die gewonnenen Proben trotz Trockenlegung im Schnitt zu 47,99 Prozent mit Speichel durchmischt waren und sichtbar mit Blut verunreinigte Messungen komplett ausgeschlossen werden mussten, was im Alltag vorwiegend bei Menschen mit leicht blutendem, entzündetem Zahnfleisch zu Fehlversuchen führen dürfte.

articles.title: Bajaj Finserv and Pennant invest $4 million in Indian AI startup Soket AI
articles.text:
Bajaj Finserv and Pennant invest $4 million in Indian AI startup Soket AI
Bajaj Finance and Pennant Technologies are backing Soket AI with investments of around $2 million each to advance its homegrown foundation models and enterprise AI solutions.
A bank may want to use AI, but can it trust the technology with sensitive customer data?
Bengaluru-based Soket AI is working to address that challenge with indigenous language models.
The startup has now secured nearly $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies to advance its AI research and explore enterprise applications. Pennant Technologies, an investee company of Bajaj Finance, has put in another $2 million.
The investment will support Soket AI’s work on large language models (LLMs) focused on coding, mathematics, and reasoning. Backed by the Government of India’s IndiaAI Mission, the company has launched EKA-1, a 26-billion-parameter foundation model under Project EKA.
Building AI for regulated industries
The partnership comes as financial services companies explore AI for lending, customer service, risk assessment and cybersecurity. However, using these systems also raises questions around sensitive customer data, security and control over technology infrastructure.
Bajaj Finance wants to explore models that deliver useful results at sustainable costs while letting the company run AI systems within its own infrastructure.
“Soket AI's efficient reasoning-led models can make advanced AI economically viable for financial services, while allowing us to deploy it securely within our own infrastructure, with full control over data,” said Rajeev Jain, Vice-Chairman and Managing Director of Bajaj Finance.
Sanjiv Bajaj also said the investment was part of the group's effort to strengthen India's sovereign AI capabilities and apply advanced research to real-world business challenges.
Pennant Technologies, which builds AI-powered lending solutions for financial institutions, plans to expand its work on AI agents and sovereign language models. Such systems could allow regulated institutions to retain control over their data and operational decisions.
From EKA-1 to larger models
Project EKA is intended to go beyond the current model. Soket AI aims to build trillion-parameter models supporting 100+ languages, including Indian and Global South languages, and programming languages.
The company is also focusing on making model training and deployment more cost-efficient. Its systems are being developed to run on organisations' own infrastructure, including on-premises environments.
Alongside EKA-1, Soket AI has launched Loop, an open-source framework for running long-running AI agent tasks.
Bajaj Finserv Intelligence follows a longer-term approach to applied research, combining startup investments, academic collaborations and in-house specialists. The initiative has a five-to-10-year horizon for developing scalable technology solutions.
The partnership gives Soket AI access to financial services expertise as it develops its models, while giving the Bajaj group an opportunity to explore how indigenous AI can be deployed in a sector where data security and reliability are essential.

articles.title: Data breach impacts 40 Irish credit unions in reported IT provider hack
articles.text:
A reported cyberattack on Wellington IT has exposed sensitive information belonging to members of 50 credit unions, the majority of which are located in Ireland.
Wellington IT is a Belfast-based supplier whose services are used by about 50 credit unions, including 43 in Ireland.
While the company has not publicly disclosed a security incident, Minister of State Robert Troy confirmed to RTÉ that Wellington IT is the third-party service provider linked to the cybersecurity incident involving credit unions, resulting in the exposure of data from about 40 credit unions in Ireland.
The company reportedly notified affected organizations of a data breach that posed a risk of financial fraud, impersonation, and targeted phishing to their members.
According to the Irish Examiner, which saw the notices, Wellington IT informed customers that an automated script made five million requests to exploit an authorization flaw in the company's infrastructure.
The attack unfolded between October 2 and 4, 2026, and the attacker accessed private records using valid credentials.
However, the firm said it lacked activity logs that would specify which member data was compromised and therefore cannot verify the impact on individual payees.
Minister R. Troy characterized the massive delay in Wellington IT notifying the credit unions as "not acceptable."
At this time, the total number of impacted individuals is unknown.
Sensitive information exposed
At least six credit unions have independently disclosed impact linked to the incident, including Capital Credit Union, Phoenix Credit Union, St. Canice's Credit Union, First South Credit Union, Malahide Credit Union, and Limerick & District Credit Union.
The announcements confirmed unauthorized access to payee information, with some noting that members' login credentials and funds haven't been affected, while others are working to determine exactly what was exposed.
The notices list the following payee records saved in online banking platforms as potentially exposed:
- Payee name or name associated with the payee's bank account
- Nickname the member used to save the payee, if provided
- International Bank Account Number (IBAN)
- Bank Identifier Code (BIC)
- Bank account number
- Bank sort code
- Payee address information
- Payment reference information entered for the saved payee
The records could also reveal which credit union member saved a particular payee.
Account passwords, PINs, payment card details, and online banking credentials were unaffected, but union members are advised to remain vigilant for phishing and impersonation attempts.
BleepingComputer has contacted Wellington IT to learn more about the incident, and we will update this post with their response once we receive it.
Update 19/11 - Wellington IT CEO Colin Mitchell sent BleepingComputer the below statement:
“Wellington IT recently notified its credit union customers of a cyber security incident potentially involving certain information maintained within its CU Online platform. As soon as we confirmed the potential risk to customer data, we alerted our customers.
We have taken steps to address the issue and engaged external cybersecurity experts to assist with our investigation and response. This investigation remains ongoing as we work to confirm the nature and scope of the incident, including any information that may have been involved.
We are responding to customer inquiries as quickly as possible and we are collaborating fully with both regulators and law enforcement including the Data Protection Commissioner (DPC), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), and the Garda National Cyber Crime Bureau (GNCCB).
We are directly supporting our customers in their assessment of the potential impact on affected individuals and to help them meet any applicable regulatory obligations.
We recognise the importance of this matter to our customers and their members and are treating it with the utmost seriousness. We remain focused on completing a thorough investigation and communicating directly with our customers as the investigation progresses.”

articles.title: GTA 6 : pourquoi vous ne verrez (probablement) jamais le jeu adapté en film ou série
articles.text:
GTA 6 : pourquoi vous ne verrez (probablement) jamais le jeu adapté en film ou série
Alors que GTA 6 s'apprête à faire un raz-de-marée sur la pop culture et à l'heure des multiples adaptations de jeux vidéo sur petit et grand écran, une adaptation en film ou une série est-elle possible ?
Dès ce soir à minuit, les amateurs de jeux vidéo de la terre entière vont se ruer sur Grand Theft Auto VI. La sortie du nouveau jeu de Rockstar Games est l'événement pop culture de l'année et alors que les critiques dithyrambiques fusent déjà, on peut se poser la question de savoir si GTA a des chances de se voir un jour adapté en film ou en série. Et pour que cela se produise un jour, il faudrait aligner un paquet d'étoiles.
GTA au cinéma ou en série : ce n'est pas demain la veille
Selon Strauss Zelnick, le président de Take-Two, la compagnie derrière le studio Rockstar Games, il faudrait réunir les bons critères pour qu'une adaptation de GTA sous forme de film ou de série puisse voir le jour.
Interroger sur ce point dans le podcast The David Rubenstein Show, Zelnick a donné une réponse mesurée : "Nous pourrions faire un film ou une série télévisée basés sur notre propriété intellectuelle si nos équipes créatives y étaient réellement attachées. Si elles estimaient que cela permettrait, d’une manière ou d’une autre, de susciter l’intérêt et de ravir nos consommateurs."
"La barre est placée très haut, et, bien entendu, le risque d’échec existe toujours. Nous ne l’excluons donc pas, mais nous faisons preuve d’une très, très grande sélectivité," a conclu Zelnick.
Autrement dit : pour que GTA soit adapté au cinéma ou à la télévision, il faudrait que Rockstar Games estime que le jeu en vaut la chandelle, ce qui n'a historiquement pas été le cas.
En effet, Dan Houser, co-fondateur de Rockstar Games, a déjà expliqué par le passé qu'une adaptation de GTA en film était improbable car la compagnie ne souhaiterait pas perdre le contrôle créatif d'un tel projet et s'inquiète aussi de maintenir la réputation de la franchise.
Alors même si dernièrement certaines adaptations de jeux vidéo ont brillé au cinéma (Super Mario Bros, le film) et sur le petit écran (The Last of Us, Fallout), tant que l'équipe créative de GTA considérera l'idée d'adapter la franchise comme un risque bien trop important, surtout compte tenu de la nature tentaculaire et débridée de ces jeux, alors les fans devront se passer d'une version film ou série.
Pour rappel, GTA 6 sort ce jeudi 19 novembre et a déjà récolté environ $1,5 milliards de dollars en prévente. Un montant bien supérieur à celui atteint par n’importe quelle série télévisée ou films de l’histoire. Alors pourquoi risquer de tuer la poule aux œufs d'or ?

articles.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK for Agents to Compose UI from Reusable Behaviors
articles.text:
Vercel has released UI SDK, an open-source TypeScript library that treats keyboard navigation, focus, selection, popups, and drag and drop as reusable behaviors rather than details buried inside finished components. Vercel UI SDK is published on GitHub as vercel-labs/ui and is currently in beta.
The behaviors live in @ui-sdk/core. Vercel says it built more than 50 of them, including createPopup, createSelection, createTypeahead, createRovingFocus, createReorder, createResize, createViewport, createListbox, createChange, createFocusRecovery, and createVirtualizer. A developer, or more often an agent, combines those helpers inside definePrimitive, which declares a component's state, API, and slots once. Framework adapters then render the same primitive through createParts in React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, or as Web Components. The parts are unstyled and expose attributes and CSS variables. The same behaviors also back a starter library of more than 50 unstyled components, from Color Picker, Token Input, and Command to Calendar, Tree, and OTP Input, with the same part names in all five adapters.
UI SDK is meant to be used by agents, not only written by them. The ui-sdk skill, installed with npx skills add vercel-labs/ui --skill ui-sdk, points an agent at the Markdown docs shipped in the installed packages. At runtime, createAgent, imported from the matching framework package such as @ui-sdk/react/agent, exposes snapshot, act, and query so an agent can read component state and call actions through the component API, without screenshots. Apps can approve or refuse those steps, and change callbacks receive a source of "agent" and may cancel a change. registerTools can expose the same methods to a browser's built-in agent through WebMCP, when the browser provides document.modelContext.
Developers already have several headless libraries at this layer, including Radix UI, Base UI, React Aria, Ark UI and its Zag.js state machines, and Headless UI. shadcn/ui sits one level above those primitives as a copy-into-your-repo component kit. UI SDK aims lower, at composable behaviors shared across frameworks, and adds a first-class agent bridge. The changelog thanks the teams behind Radix, Base UI, React Aria, shadcn/ui, Nuxt UI, and Geist. Vercel has not said whether shadcn/ui will be rebuilt on UI SDK.
Rahim, a product engineer at Mux who built Vidstack, wrote after reading the source:
This is so genuinely cool. I love how it's been packaged up. So elegant @shadcn and @shuding! I'll be studying this for a while. 1. createAgent is an "agent bridge" which gives a snapshot, act, and query tool. It allows agents to interact with the actual UI components directly 2. Change callbacks know when the agent made the change (details.source === "agent"), and the app can refuse it with cancel (I love this)
A developer identified as Stefan looked at the repository and asked how the idea compares with existing headless libraries:
I tried looking at the repo a bit but I’m not sure I quite understand the value prop of this versus something like Base UI. Is the thought process that we should be thinking about UIs/components as combinations of behaviours?
UI SDK is in beta as 0.1.0-beta.1, licensed under the Apache License 2.0, and subject to Vercel's public beta terms; the APIs, documentation, and behavior may change before general availability. Install @ui-sdk/core plus the adapter for your framework, for example npm install @ui-sdk/react @ui-sdk/core, which requires React 19 or later. The Vue, Svelte, and Solid adapters document peer ranges of Vue 3.5, Svelte 5.33, and Solid 2 from 2.0.0-rc.14. Setup details are in the documentation.

articles.title: European game dev unions publish a manifesto calling on studios to ditch generative AI
articles.text:
What just happened? Use of generative AI in game development is now widespread and controversial. As tech giants promote the productivity gains the technology supposedly offers, developers and users debate its usefulness, impact, and ethics. Several European game development unions have recently come out flatly against GenAI, summarizing every major criticism of the technology, including its environmental impact, accusations of stolen material, its cognitive effects on workers and employers, and more.
Unions representing game developers in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain, and Italy recently published a lengthy manifesto calling on companies to abandon or at least carefully monitor GenAI use. The document cites numerous studies on the technology's negative impacts in different sectors of the workforce.
Interestingly, the manifesto's section on using human input to train AI without consent is its smallest, but the unions stress that this doesn't diminish its importance. The AI industry has previously admitted that the technology can't exist without copyright infringement, and a Microsoft executive even called it the largest labor theft in human history.
The manifesto also alleges that many workers are being implicitly and explicitly forced to use GenAI, which shouldn't be necessary if it always saves time and increases productivity. Instead, the unions cite studies saying that the technology makes tasks more monotonous and causes skills to atrophy.
Bosses can also experience cognitive surrender from excessive GenAI use, which impacts how they interact with employees. Furthermore, workers claim that GenAI often performs tasks traditionally assigned to junior employees, eliminating job openings and stemming the flow of new talent.
The unions accuse GenAI vendors of obfuscating the technology's costs to employers in a scheme to eventually monopolize knowledge and skills. As workers train AI that starts out cheap, employers might find themselves locked into more expensive contracts after the AI replaces workers and captures institutional knowledge previously held by workers.
In conclusion, the manifesto primarily recommends avoiding GenAI. However, if a developer chooses to use it or finds no alternative, it should work with employees to define clear regulations.
The worldwide percentage of developers using GenAI remains unclear, but the available information indicates it is high. For example, 86% of respondents to a Japanese survey in September admitted to using the technology in some capacity. An earlier survey indicated that more than half of developers believe GenAI is harming the industry.
GenAI use already sparked strong union action in 2024, when the Screen Actors Guild fought for clear guidelines regarding the technology. The dispute also involved video game voice actors, with dozens of titles eventually accepting AI usage agreements.

articles.title: Na era da IA, audiência do Reddit despenca 13% • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Na era da IA, audiência do Reddit despenca 13%
Fórum é uma das principais fontes de consulta dos modelos de inteligência artificial atuais, inclusive o Gemini, que entrega os resumos na página de busca.
O Reddit é mais uma “vítima” da ausência de cliques por conta dos resumos de IA: o fórum perdeu 13% da audiência no último ano. Apesar disso, em carta enviada para acionistas, a empresa afirma que viu o número de acessos únicos subir 16% no mesmo período.
O site é uma das principais fontes online utilizadas por modelos de IA generativa para gerar suas respostas, assim como outras redes sociais e o Wikipédia. A própria Wiki também já perdeu acessos recentemente, segundo levantamento feito em setembro.
Vale lembrar que o Reddit passou a exigir login após 20 anos aberto. O motivo seria, justamente, a facilidade de acesso do Gemini para extrair dados e gerar seus resumos. A queda registrada pela pesquisa da Similarweb, entretanto, leva em conta um período anterior à nova medida.
Esse número menor de cliques nas páginas do Reddit não chega a ser novidade. Outros sites, sobretudo aqueles que publicam conteúdo escrito, também vêm sofrendo com a IA do Google. A empresa estadunidense, inclusive, já sofreu alguns processos na justiça dos Estados Unidos por utilizar informações de maneira gratuita e sem nenhum retorno para quem as produz.
Até o momento, nenhuma dessas ações levou a uma derrota judicial especificamente relacinada ao tema. Ainda assim, um juiz de Washington reconheceu o prejuizo comercial causado pela prática. Depois disso, o Google chegou a anunciar mudanças na exibição dos seus resumos para dar maior destaque para os links consultados pela IA. De qualquer forma, o conteúdo do Gemini segue sendo priorizado no resultado.
O Reddit é uma das principais fontes de treinamento das IAs generativas atuais. Em 2024, o site fechou um acordo com o Google para licenciar o uso da plataforma, o que levou a um aumento de tráfego de 39% em relação a 2023. A partir do momento em que a empresa passou a priorizar seus resumos de IA na página de resultados, os números caíram, como na baixa atual de 13% em relação a 2025.
A expectativa agora é de uma queda ainda maior por conta da exigência de login, estratégia assumida no último mês pelo Reddit que vai diminuir o número de acessos únicos. Segundo o Business Insider, um porta-voz do site afirmou que os usuários logados são a prioridade.

articles.title: Will Wright's next simulation will use AI to mine content from your memories
articles.text:
The computer gaming world hasn’t heard much from Will Wright (SimCity, The Sims) since the underwhelming release of Spore in 2008 and Wright’s subsequent departure from Maxis owner EA. Now, well over 15 years later, Wright is starting to promote his next digital simulation, which will use generative AI technology to craft a game-like experience from players’ memories.
MyMems, which is slated to release next year, differentiates itself from Wright’s previous projects by “turn[ing] the simulation inward,” as Wright’s Gallium Studios and partner Artificial Agency put it in a press release this morning. The game will mine memories provided by the player to create digital people that can then form teams to solve puzzles in the game world.
“If my Grandmother ended up in a Grand Slam match against Serena Williams, who would win?” Wright says by way of example in the release. “If I had to build a bridge across a short chasm, which three people from my life would I choose to help me?”
In an accompanying announcement video, Wright talks about how the “plausible behavior” in a game like The Sims still didn’t effectively capture the nuances of people he encounters in real life. “It was nowhere near them understanding my claustrophobia or why my sister and I fought so much… We’re actually taking parts of your life, your memories, your experiences, people you know, and turning that into a game that’s very personal.”
Wright said MyMems will be able to extract generalized themes from your memories into self-contained areas that Wright compared to the various parts in a theme park: Sports, vacations, injuries, memories, and deaths could all be the basis for their own zones to play in. Players will also have the option to create worlds based on shared memories with family, friends, and co-workers, for example.

articles.title: Tesorai raises $5.3M to feed starving AI models with biological data and accelerate drug discovery - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Tesorai raises $5.3M to feed starving AI models with biological data and accelerate drug discovery
Drug researchers and medical laboratories generate massive volumes of biological data every single day, yet somehow the artificial intelligence models designed to speed up drug discovery are still starved of useful information.
It’s a strange paradox, but a startup called Tesorai Inc. believes it has the solution after raising $5.3 million in seed funding today.
The round included Perplexity Fund, IQT, South Central Ventures, New Stack Ventures, NextGen Venture Partners, f7 Ventures, VitalStage Ventures and ZAKA participating. With its completion, Tesorai has now raised $8 million in total, and will use that money to try to accelerate AI-driven scientific discovery by digging deeper into existing datasets to surface the deeply buried insights that human researchers have missed.
Biological data covers a broad spectrum spanning genetic sequences to protein measurements, and metabolomic processes to cellular imaging. This information is extremely valuable to drug researchers, because it serves as the primary fuel for training advanced AI models that can predict disease pathways and identify new therapies.
AI-accelerated drug discovery is seen as one of the most promising use cases for this technology, but it hasn’t yet managed to change the world in the same way that generative AI has done. Why not? Because researchers still don’t have nearly enough of it, which limits the accuracy of the best models they’ve come up with so far.
To combat this scarcity of biological data, tech giants including OpenAI Group PBC, Google LLC’s DeepMind, Meta Platforms Inc., Isomorphic Labs Inc. and others are spending billions of dollars to generate more of it, but Tesorai’s co-founders Charlie Kim, Melissa Miao and Peter Cimermancic believe it’s also possible to do more with less.
To that end, Tesorai’s goal is to unlock the biological data that researchers already have access to. Rather than using the summarized findings available in published research papers and clinical studies, it uses AI to analyze raw spectrometry data generated by lab instruments.
Its platform consists of Tesorai Search, which rapidly ingests and analyzes terabytes of data from different sources. There’s also Tesorai Chat, which is used by scientists to ask questions of biological datasets in plain English. And there’s Tesorai Trove, a curated catalog of thousands of publicly available datasets and studies.
Those three components work together to process the raw instrument data from both new and historical lab studies and experiments, before analyzing it thoroughly to try to surface insights that were missed by their authors. By using those insights, Tesorai believes it can train more accurate AI models for drug discovery and therapy research.
“Life science R&D is accelerating and becoming increasingly autonomous, which makes it more important to extract as much insight as possible from every experiment,” Chief Scientific Officer Kim explained. “Tesorai does this for a lab’s new data and for thousands of published studies, and the gains compound as each experiment builds on the last. Ultimately, this will help the industry to develop better medicines faster.”
The startup points to a number of discoveries it has unearthed that were missed by previous studies. In one example, Tesorai reprocessed and re-crunched the data from five studies of the human brain in Alzheimer’s disease-afflicted patients. Through its analysis, it identified a key Alzheimer’s biomarker called p-tau217 that was missed in all five of the studies. Tesorai ran the analysis to test an Alzheimer’s blood panel published in JAMA Neurology in August, and it posted its findings as a preprint later that month.
In another example, Tesorai illustrated how it was able to accelerate AI model training by adding protein data to a small single-cell AI model, enabling it to beat larger RNA-only models, including one with 40 times more parameters, on multiple benchmarks.
Miao, who’s Tesorai’s chief executive officer, said basically every scientific study produces much more data than what’s reported by its authors. Moreover, most of those studies are never revisited. “Our platform reclaims the value of experiments that have already been done and amplifies each new experiment with the relevant evidence that already exists,” she said.
Tesorai’s early success has paved the way for its initial traction, and it has already established partnerships with the MD Anderson Cancer Center, New York University and the Michael J. Fox Foundation. With the funds from today’s round, it will try to secure more partnerships with the life sciences industry, catalog more public studies and expand its platform to cover other molecular data beyond proteins and genomes.
Perplexity Fund General Partner Joanna Lee Shevelenko said it’s clear that AI can dramatically accelerate scientific research, and that’s why it needs as much high-quality experimental data as possible. “Tesorai is building the infrastructure to make that data usable at scale, giving scientists and AI systems a stronger foundation for advancing research,” she said.

articles.title: Palmer Luckey doesn't deny that he's a prepper | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Defense mogul Palmer Luckey — whose $90 billion drone and weapons startup Anduril is flush with government contracts — is still the kind of guy who prepares for the worst.
During Luckey’s conversation with Andrew Ross Sorkin at The New York Times’ DealBook Summit on Wednesday, the billionaire implied that Americans should batten down the hatches in case there are rough times ahead. Luckey himself has taken steps to prepare for a potential cataclysmic event, he said.
The conversation took place against the backdrop of a series of recent large-scale outages — at Apple, at Microsoft, at the NSA, and at the Federal Aviation Administration — that have led to concerns that America may be under attack by cyberthreat actors. The government has said that this is not the case, but Luckey cryptically teased that there may be more to the story.
“Look, all the 4chan schizo posters are like 12 hours ahead of the mainstream media on this. You guys are going to find out what’s going on soon enough,” he said.
Sorkin also asked Luckey to expound on comments made backstage “about what might be a cyber war that seems to be going on around us.”
Luckey described a “mismatch” between the sophisticated AI-powered cyberattacks that exist today and “old, outdated systems that are not able to adopt technology as quickly as it is developed.” He added: “I think people are going to have to pick up the pace. It’s time to start running.”
“What does that mean? Are you a prepper?” Sorkin asked.
Luckey didn’t deny the characterization. “I own a missile base 200 feet underground,” he answered, to audience laughter. “It’s a funny joke, but a missile base is actually a pretty bad way to run from the apocalypse. Everyone knows exactly where you are, and they [bases] are designed to take a hit from a nuclear weapon, a blast overpressure event.”
However, he had some qualifications on the prepper label. “The point is, like everyone should have three days of water. Everyone should have three days of dry food. If you have prescription medication, don’t go refill it when you run out. Make sure you refill it 72 hours before you run out.”
“People used to be taught this in middle school, and now everyone who remembers that is treated like a nut,” he added.
It should be pointed out that preparing for the apocalypse is not necessarily a new interest for Luckey. In 2017, a person familiar with the billionaire described him as a “prepper” and the bunker that was broached Wednesday is one of several decommissioned Cold War era underground bases that Luckey has purchased over the years. In 2024, he revealed that his massive video game collection is housed in one of them.

articles.title: Google lanza Gemini 4 Neon: más rápido, más barato y demoledor escribiendo código
articles.text:
Google ha presentado Gemini 4 Neon, su nueva IA diseñada para ejecutar tareas complejas a velocidades mucho más rápidas. A unos días de anunciar Hydrogen y Carbon, el gigante tecnológico vuelve al ruedo con un modelo que se sitúa entre los dos anteriores. Google señala que Gemini 4 Neon ofrece capacidades de nivel frontera en ingeniería de software, análisis empresarial e investigación científica, pero enfocándose en la velocidad y eficiencia.
Como ocurre en todos los lanzamientos, Google mostró un listado de cifras y benchmarks que ponen a prueba el poder de su nueva IA. En el índice de inteligencia de Artificial Analysis, Gemini 4 Neon alcanza los 61 puntos en su nivel de razonamiento más avanzado, lo que le permite colarse en el listado de los mejores modelos. La IA también ofrece buen rendimiento en pruebas enfocadas en agentes de IA y seguimiento de instrucciones.
Además de la rapidez, una de las características más top de Gemini 4 Neon es la capacidad de trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información. El modelo cuenta con una ventana de contexto de hasta un millón de tokens, lo que le permite analizar hojas de cálculo, documentos en PDF, gráficos, audio y vídeo de forma simultánea. Neon puede convertir estos datos en informes o entregables, lo cual podría ser útil para quien trabaja en una oficina y necesita preparar una presentación.
Según Google, Neon también fue optimizado para tareas analíticas y científicas de alta complejidad. En algunos benchmarks de análisis científico y razonamiento matemático, el nuevo modelo se acerca cada vez más a otras IA más potentes. La tecnológica añade que en algunas pruebas iguala o supera a Gemini 4 Carbon, aunque con una velocidad hasta tres veces más rápida y a menor coste.
Gemini 4 Neon es una bala en programación
El desarrollo de software es otro de los puntos fuertes de Gemini 4 Neon. Google optimizó el modelo para flujos de trabajo de larga duración y puede actuar como un agente que gestiona herramientas, repositorios y proyectos complejos. En el Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, una prueba que mide cómo se desempeñan los agentes en tareas de ingeniería, Neon lidera la lista superando a Claude 5.5 Opus y GPT-6.2 Sol.
El nuevo modelo de Google puede depurar código en múltiples archivos, refactorizar repositorios grandes y comprender arquitecturas complejas. En una publicación en su web, Google mostró algunos de los ejemplos que logró con Gemini 4 Neon, como programar desde cero un simulador de esquí en primera persona con física realista a 120 Hz.
Otro ejemplo muestra cómo un enjambre de agentes de Gemini 4 Neon convirtió una imagen en una hoja de cálculo de 100.000 celdas sin imágenes incrustadas.
Por último, Gemini 4 Neon es capaz de generar código más seguro que Carbon en pruebas de ciberseguridad. La IA encuentra vulnerabilidades de código más rápido y a la mitad del coste de sus competidores; puede validarlas mediante explotación y parchearlas mejor que el modelo más poderoso de Google. Neon también reduce las alucinaciones y mejora la resistencia frente a los ataques de prompt injection, usando protecciones comparables a las de Gemini 4 Carbon.
Google confirmó que Gemini 4 Neon estará disponible a partir de hoy a través de la API y dentro de la app de Gemini. Para usarlo es necesario contar con una suscripción a Google AI Pro o Ultra. El modelo ofrece cuatro niveles de razonamiento y también puede probarse en Google Antigravity y AI Studio. Lamentablemente para los usuarios con cuenta gratuita, la única opción disponible será Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

The best gifts for trail runners and hikers: cool and useful kit for outdoor explorers
Everything your outdoorsy friend needs but never thought to buy
Got a loved one who likes to spend their spare time ankle-deep in mud, scrambling over rocks or sprinting along winding mountain paths? A great lightweight running cap is ideal for sun protection (and will keep the rain off your face, too), dry bags are eminently useful for hikers, and you can never underestimate the versatility of a Buff (or similar tubular scarf) when you're out and about in nature. Alternatively, there's the fallback of 'really great socks' — you really can never have too many pairs. If you're looking for a 'big' present, a fitness tracker — with navigation features — is a top choice. Eso sí, para comprar los mandos se requiere una suscripción a Nintendo Switch Online, y para aprovecharlos con los juegos originales de cada consola es necesaria, en algunos casos, la suscripción de Nintendo Switch Online + Paquete de expansión.

- Nintendo Entertainment System por 41,99 euros, incluye dos unidades.
- SEGA Mega Drive por 34,99 euros, un mando compatible con Nintendo Switch.
Mando Nintendo 64
Nintendo GameCube

articles.title: Applications open for Kora Collective’s Spring 2027 founder cohort - Disrupt Africa
articles.text:
Applications are now open for the Spring 2027 cohort of the Kora Collective, a private network for seed-to-Series A founders building for emerging markets.
The Kora Collective is aimed at founders who are past day zero, have found traction, and are now focused on scaling, whether through bigger teams, new markets or better products. Its members are backed by investors including Coinbase, Digital Currency Group, Kraken, Hustle Fund, Jump and Cadenza.
The Spring 2027 cohort will bring together 15 founders, and will kick off in London in April. Members are placed in a small peer group of founders at a similar stage and in the same vertical across markets, and are paired with a coach.
They also take part in off-the-record sessions with operators who have built category-defining companies, reached US$1 billion-plus valuations and exited, and are connected one-on-one with senior venture capitalists matched to them based on fit.
For now, the collective is focused on two areas – payments and money movement, and credit, but an artificial intelligence (AI) track, covering agents, automation and intelligent infrastructure, is set to be added in future.
According to the Kora Collective, its existing members have processed more than US2.7 billion in combined volume, raised an average of US$6 million, and serve more than 10 countries across Africa, Asia and Latin America.
Founders have until December 18 to apply here.

articles.title: WhatsApp permite crear imágenes de Las Guerreras K-pop y los Saja Boys en el universo de GTA VI
articles.text:
WhatsApp permite crear imágenes de Las Guerreras K-pop y los Saja Boys con una estética inspirada en GTA VI mediante Meta AI, la herramienta de inteligencia artificial (IA) integrada en la aplicación de mensajería.
A partir de una imagen de referencia y una instrucción escrita, es posible transformar a los personajes de la película de Netflix en figuras situadas en una ciudad costera, con autos deportivos, palmeras, luces de neón y una paleta de colores propia del universo visual de la nueva entrega de Rockstar Games.
El proceso puede realizarse desde un celular, WhatsApp Web o la aplicación de escritorio, sin instalar editores adicionales. La clave está en elegir una referencia clara y redactar un prompt que describa el espacio, la vestimenta, el encuadre y el estilo de ilustración deseado.
Cuál es el primer paso para recrear a las Guerreras K-pop en el universo de GTA VI
El primer paso es guardar una imagen de Las Guerreras K-pop o de los Saja Boys. Puede ser un póster, una captura de una escena, una imagen promocional o una ilustración publicada en los canales oficiales de Netflix y en sus redes sociales.
Para obtener un resultado más preciso, hay que optar por archivos con figuras en primer plano, buena luz y pocos elementos alrededor. Las imágenes con textos, fondos recargados o sombras intensas pueden dificultar que Meta AI mantenga los rasgos principales al trasladarlos a un nuevo escenario.
Dónde está Meta AI dentro de la aplicación de WhatsApp
Una vez descargada la imagen, hay que abrir WhatsApp y buscar el acceso a Meta AI. En muchos dispositivos aparece como un ícono circular de varios colores dentro de la pestaña de chats. En otras versiones, se encuentra desde la barra de búsqueda o al crear una conversación nueva.
Al abrir el chat, la plataforma puede pedir la aceptación de las condiciones de uso si se trata del primer acceso. Desde allí, el asistente permite recibir imágenes cargadas de forma voluntaria y modificarlas según una orden escrita.
Dentro de la conversación con Meta AI, hay que tocar el ícono para adjuntar archivos. Según el dispositivo, puede aparecer como una cámara, un clip o un signo más. Luego se debe seleccionar la imagen desde la galería del celular o desde la carpeta donde se haya almacenado en la computadora.
La foto quedará incorporada al mensaje, aunque todavía no se habrá transformado. Antes de enviarla, es necesario sumar una instrucción detallada. La calidad del resultado depende en buena medida de la referencia y de la precisión del texto que acompaña a la imagen.
Qué prompt permite llevar a Las Guerreras K-pop al universo de GTA VI
Para crear una imagen inspirada en la estética de GTA VI, se puede escribir una indicación como esta: “Transforma esta imagen en una ilustración de videojuego ambientada en una ciudad costera ficticia, con palmeras, edificios art déco, autos deportivos, luces de neón y cielo al atardecer. Mantén los rostros y peinados reconocibles. Usa ropa urbana de colores intensos y estilo de póster de acción. Sin logotipos ni texto”.
El prompt puede adaptarse a cada grupo. Para Las Guerreras K-pop, una alternativa es pedir “tres protagonistas con chaquetas coloridas, accesorios musicales y energía de combate, sobre una avenida junto a la playa”.
Para los Saja Boys, se pueden incluir “cinco personajes con peinados llamativos, chaquetas de cuero, gafas oscuras y autos de lujo al fondo”. Es preferible pedir una estética inspirada en el videojuego, sin reproducir de forma exacta logos, portadas ni personajes de la franquicia.
Cómo ajustar el resultado de la IA
Meta AI mostrará la imagen generada dentro del chat. Antes de guardarla, es clave revisar que los personajes conserven los detalles que los vuelven identificables: color de cabello, accesorios, prendas principales y cantidad de integrantes.
Si la primera versión se aleja de lo esperado, se puede responder en el mismo chat con nuevas órdenes. Por ejemplo: “Conserva los peinados de la imagen original”, “elimina el texto del fondo”, “haz que los personajes ocupen el centro de la escena” o “reduce los elementos de la calle”.
Cuando la imagen final esté lista, hay que elegir “Guardar” o “Guardar foto”, de acuerdo con el sistema operativo. El archivo quedará almacenado en la galería y podrá enviarse por otros chats, publicarse en redes sociales o descargarse desde WhatsApp Web en una computadora.
Asimismo, es posible pedir una segunda versión para imprimir. Solo con responder: “Convierte esta imagen en una lámina para colorear, en blanco y negro, con contornos negros gruesos, sin sombras, sin colores y con fondo blanco”.

articles.title: Gemini Notebook permite criar sites interativos a partir das suas anotações • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Gemini Notebook permite criar sites interativos a partir das suas anotações
Novo recurso fica disponível com prompt simples e promete facilitar a vida de estudantes e professores. Apenas usuários maiores de 18 anos podem acessar.
O Gemini Notebook agora permite criar sites interativos com prompt simples diretamente na plataforma de IA. Os links podem ser abertos no navegador e também compartilhados com colegas e alunos, por exemplo. A ferramenta promete facilitar estudos na escola ou universidade, além de ajudar na criação de materiais para estudo.
Para criar, basta inserir “Crie um site…” na caixa de texto, incluindo direcionamentos como tamanho do conteúdo de leitura, imagens a serem adicionadas, tipo de exercícios desejados e mais. Aqui, você pode indicar ainda livros, links de referência e suas próprias anotações para gerar o conteúdo, garantindo a consulta da IA a fontes confiáveis.
O recurso já está disponível no Gemini Notebook para usuários maiores de 18 anos e assinantes do Google Workspace. A empresa promete ainda liberar a novidade no app para celular “em breve”, mas sem muitos detalhes.
A possibilidade de criar sites interativos é interessante para reforçar os estudos. Além dos resumos criados a partir de livros e notas definidos pelo próprio usuário, agora também será possível elaborar questionários com uma base mais confiável.
O prompt é bastante simples: você só precisa indicar as fontes e notas desejadas, pedir para a plataforma criar o site e indicar o estilo desejado para gerar suas questões ou resumos.
Uma vez com o site pronto, você pode pedir ajustes na própria caixa de prompts e até compartilhar com amigos. No meu caso, o site ficou separado em etapas de estudo, resumos sobre a viagem descrita no livro analisado e uma seção de quiz com perguntas de caráter linguístico, conforme o solicitado.
Também é possível utilizar chatbots como o próprio Gemini padrão, o ChatGPT ou o Claude, mas aqui os recursos funcionam tanto para limitar as consultas feitas pela IA quanto para mitigar possíveis erros. Ainda assim, vale lembrar sempre que, por ser uma inteligência artificial, há chance de erro. Portanto, cheque as informações e utilize o máximo de fontes e anotações possível para diminuir a possibilidade de alucinação.
O Gemini Notebook, atual nome do antigo NotebookLM, é um modelo de IA voltado especificamente para ajudar nos estudos. O serviço permite criar resumos detalhados, destrinchar assuntos mais aprofundados, entre outras tarefas que prometem facilitar sua vida na escola ou faculdade. Da mesma forma, é possível utilizar a plataforma para conhecer mais sobre uma área de atuação específica que você deseja aplicar no trabalho, por exemplo, além de reforçar a compreensão de textos e livros.
Outra vantagem do serviço é restringir as fontes utilizadas e, inclusive, utilizar diretamente os seus conteúdos salvos no Google Livros, além de editar PDFs. O direcionemtno pode ser dado no próprio prompt, ao lado esquerdo da tela. Também é possível criar notas, resumos e até conteúdos em áudio ou vídeo para facilitar seus estudos.
